column1: # tools/android/ui_strings.tsv — the SINGLE source of truth for the UMP
# Android app's short UI strings, in the SAME 32-language set as the
# language; tab-separated columns. Run tools/android/gen_strings.py to
#   tagline  — HUMAN-APPROVED. Taken verbatim from line 3 of each
#              belongs to no one is raised" — yurikago/ゆりかご). Edit the
#              manifesto, then mirror line 3 here. As of the i18n-complete
#              wave ALL 32 langs carry the yurikago tagline (the product name
#              "yurikago" is left untranslated in every language; "cradle" is
#              deliberately NOT used). The four pref toggles (battery_safe,
#              floor_label, wifi_only, start_on_boot) are likewise filled for
#              all 32 — no column falls back to English anymore.
#   all other columns (start / solo_sub / node_id / advanced / relay_*
#              / stop / galaxy / lighting / charge / star_* / sleep / copy
#              / the four prefs) — MACHINE-TRANSLATED by Claude (the
#              implementer), translated per-language as carefully as possible.
#              Native review welcome and expected; corrections are a one-line
#              edit here + a rerun of the generator.
# The 'lang' column is the manifesto tag. gen_strings.py maps it to the
# Android resource qualifier (e.g. zh-Hans -> b+zh+Hans, fil -> fil, pt -> pt).
# 'ja' is the canonical/default and is ALSO written to values/ (the base)
# only as a comment reference — the base values/strings.xml stays English so
# an unlisted locale falls back to en, matching the manifesto's en fallback.
#   lang  tagline  start  solo_sub  node_id  advanced  relay_host  relay_port  relay_key  stop  galaxy
